classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: When I was young I enjoyed playing with sticks and stones, fighting and defeating all of my father's scarecrows, dreamed about becoming a powerful warrior that defeats his foes and now here I am ready for my next challenge!

abilities.name: Heroic Leap
abilities.description: You leap a great distance with great strength!
abilities.effect: Allows reaching Bart in the void prison scenario

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: Are you thirsty? sorry, my water is not drinkable! Hungry? I can... cook... our enemies! Travel from town to town in a blink of an eye? show me your money!

abilities.name: Magical Ground
abilities.description: You create a magical ground to walk on
abilities.effect: Allows creating a path in yellow stone scenario and void prison

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: In a realm of Myst Where the dreams come true, There we are in search of Bartholomew Also known as 'Bart the claw cuddler' And I have no idea how we will rescue him Deep in darkness is where we go Fingers crossed is what we hope Bart, here we come!

abilities.name: Magical Books
abilities.description: You use magic books and sing songs
abilities.effect: Allows creating a path in yellow stone scenario and void prison

classes.name: Clerk
classes.description: In this dark world, instead of using swords, shields, or knives, I prefer to use my hands... to pray and heal others, but also to unleash the holy power upon our enemies, I prefer to work with a group of misfits, but in the end, if you pay me enough... I mean if you show me your great gratitude, I can go anywhere

abilities.name: Holy Prayer
abilities.description: You pray to the Holy Light
abilities.effect: Provides levitation and distraction abilities in various scenarios
